dedupe_keys.name: cier electricity statistics for latin america and the caribbean annual synthesis interconnections report and online dashboard

description: CIER, the regional energy integration commission of electricity companies and bodies in Latin America and the Caribbean, runs a portal of electricity statistics for its member countries covering generation, integration and transmission. The data are published in an annual report, the Síntesis Informativa Energética de los Países de la CIER, and consolidated in an online dashboard with charts and tables of the main indicators, such as installed capacity, energy generated, transmission lines, renewable energy and consumption per inhabitant. A companion document describes international interconnections between countries, with their main characteristics and exchanges. The latest edition is the 2023 synthesis with the 2024 interconnections report, offered as one ZIP file (about 2.5 MB, posted September 2025). Coverage: CIER member countries in Latin America and the Caribbean; the member list was not read. Format and access: annual reports in a ZIP download and an online dashboard; free. Licence: not read. Caveats: only the portal page was read; the report's tables, the dashboard's export options and the years covered before 2023 were not checked. The text is in Spanish. Simulation uses: national installed capacity, generation, transmission line lengths and cross-border interconnection capacity and flows for regional power system and interconnection studies.
